units: overlay points, origin top-left, y down; every rational [numerator, denominator]; transform {a, b, c, d, tx, ty} maps (x, y) to (a·x + c·y + tx, b·x + d·y + ty) in device pixels
notes: b10-two-fill-rectangles: a box with two fill rectangles: the veil, the edge and the edge keyline keyed <id>:<i>, each onPaint mark framed from the veil with the same key suffix. b5-tag-turned-words: a tag whose step carries its words' transform, carried unchanged in its drawn-mark description. The steps are the model's (a pure value list): kind, key, group, geometry in overlay points (on-screen sizes times fingerScale), colour, opacity, width. The veils' group carries the opacity. veilLines are the device lines of each fill's frame (every veil, the whole page's and the moved box's), by step key; the spec carries the rectangle only. The lift (lift-*; the moving group) and the Differentiate Without Colour cue (dwc-*; the only path specs with a dash); inputs carry moving, liftGrows and settings.differentiateWithoutColor.

cases.why: b1: a box at rest, at fit on a 3× device: edge keyline, keyline, veil, faint edge, line, with the canvas's sizes and colours, each in its group; the veil an opaque ink rectangle in a group of opacity 0.18
b2: the same box at zoom 2: every on-screen size is the same number of screen points; the veil's frame lies on device lines for that transform
b2: the same box at zoom 5.12: every on-screen size is the same number of screen points; the veil's frame lies on device lines for that transform
b3: two boxes whose paint overlaps: two opaque veils in the veils' group, which has the opacity (0.18) and group opacity: the overlap is not darker
b4: a selected box (single): its handles as discs with a ring and a shadow; with handleScale 1 the disc and the shadow are full size, and the ring's width does not change
b4: a selected box (single): its handles as discs with a ring and a shadow; with handleScale 0.5 the disc and the shadow halve, and the ring's width does not change
b6: a page shown turned 90°: the veil's frame lies on device lines through the quarter-turn transform (ScreenLink.fillRect extended)

two regions the plan joined share one paint: one veil, one faint edge and one edge keyline for the pair; two lines, each on its own rectangle; selecting one makes only its line heavy (here q is selected, not alone, so its line is heavy and it draws dots)
Increase Contrast: an ink line 1 pt wide beside the line, the keyline further out by that width, the faint edge at 80 %
Reduce Transparency: the veils' group opacity 0.26
two boxes selected: each draws four dots (discs with a ring), no handles
b5: a found box at rest at zoom 2 (its line 26 pt tall on screen): its tag as a drawn-mark spec in the tags' group, after the lines, its content scale the screen's 3 times the zoom (6 px a point)
b5: at zoom 10 the drawn mark's content scale is capped at 24 pixels a point (3 × 10 = 30)
b5: at fit the line is about 8 pt tall on screen: no tag spec
b5: the same found box selected at zoom 2: no tag spec (a tag is shown only at rest)

b5 on a page shown turned 90°: the tag's step carries its words' transform, a quarter turn about the tag's centre (a 0, b −1, c 1, d 0: x across as shown, y down as shown); the tag's layer description carries it unchanged, and the layer drawer draws the words in it into the layer's own bitmap
b5: a page marked whole, at rest: path specs for the two hatches, the inner keyline, the veil (its own layer, opacity 0.07) and the frame (2 pt, centre 3 inside the edge), in the whole page's group
b5: the whole page selected: its frame page teal at the selected line's width, with handles, the handles' group above the whole page's
b5: under Increase Contrast the whole page's frame is opaque ink

the lift keeps its shadow and loses its growth: a single moved box (selected, its handles off while it moves) beside one at rest, at fit: its edge keyline, keyline, veil, faint edge and line made from its own paint and line, at their resting size, in the moving group, after every other group; its veil snapped from its paint, at its own opacity 0.18, casting the lift's shadow (offset 4, Core Graphics blur 12, black 20 %, on-screen points); no handles; the box at rest unchanged
the same at zoom 2: no growth at any zoom; the shadow and the widths the same on-screen points

COMPARISON (not the look of record): the lift as the canvas drew it before (+Draw.swift:35-37), each mark of the moved box grown by 1 % of its width and height on each side. The growth is removed; a build must not reproduce this row

Differentiate Without Colour, two boxes selected: each carries the dashed outline (black, 2 wide, dashes 4 and 3 from phase 0, 3 outside the box) over a white under-stroke at 90 %, 3.6 wide, same path and dash, as path specs with a dash, in the handles' group before the dots
Differentiate Without Colour, one box selected in Add to Selection (no handles, its dots): the cue, as for a multi-selection
Differentiate Without Colour, one box selected alone, with handles: no cue

a box with two fill rectangles (the run's fill: [CGRect]) side by side, sharing a side: veil, edge and edge keyline keyed name:0 and name:1, each edge and edge keyline framed from its own veil's snapped frame by the key's suffix; one keyline and one line for the box. Each rectangle draws its own edge, the seam included: a merged outline is not built in 1.4.0
